name: SMU S.A.
summary: SMU S.A. operates a chain of supermarkets in Chile. The company offers fresh items, such as fruits and vegetables, white and red meats, and dairy products, as well as dry goods, wine and spirits, frozen and cleaning products, and various non-food items; and ready meals, chocolates, beverages, pastries, bread, and tobacco products. It operates food retail business through various formats comprising supermarkets under the Unimarc and Mayorista 10 name; cash and carry stores under the Alvi names; convenience stores under the Ok Market name; and online through Telemercados name. As of March 15, 2021, it operated 284 Unimarc stores, 63 Mayorista 10 stores, 32 Alvi stores, 125 Ok Market, and 25 Mayorsa stores. SMU S.A. was founded in 2007 and is based in Las Condes, Chile.
